lines.japanese: さあ、お昼の時間だ！
lines.english: At last, lunchtime!

lines.japanese: 最近は友達が出来たから、お昼ごはんが楽しみで仕方ない。小鳩の愛妹弁当もあるしな。一日の中で、小鳩や森里君と話してる時間に次いで楽しい時間だな。
lines.english: Now that I had friends, I couldn't wait for lunch each day. I also had Kobato's loving little-sister lunch. After talking with Kobato and Morisato, this was the best part of my day.

lines.japanese: いつも渡来明日香や山科京や針生蔵人らが、勝手に俺の席に集まってくれるしな。
lines.english: Asuka Watarai, Miyako Yamashina, and Kuroudo always gathered around my desk without even being invited.

lines.japanese: どれ、今日は気分がいい。たまには班長自ら声をかけてみるか。
lines.english: Hmm. I was in a fine mood today. Perhaps the team leader should call everyone together himself for once.

lines.japanese: それじゃあ、ヨッくんの教えにならって元気よく！
lines.english: Following Yoshi's teachings, I would greet them with spirit!

lines.japanese: 「人の目を見て話さない！　今日も無礼な針生くーん！」
lines.english: “Never looks you in the eye! As rude as ever—Kuroudo!”

lines.japanese: 「一緒にごはん食べようゼ！」
lines.english: “Let's eat together!”

lines.japanese: 「先輩なら今日休み。鍾乳洞見に行ってる」
lines.english: “Kuroudo's out today. Went to see some limestone caves.”

lines.japanese: 「羽田班の紅一点！　今日も不元気な山科さーん！」
lines.english: “The lone flower of Team Haneda! Looking listless as ever—Yamashina!”

lines.japanese: 「山科も今日休み。体調崩したって今朝メールあった」
lines.english: “Yamashina's out too. She emailed this morning to say she was sick.”

lines.japanese: 「おいおい、いつの間に二人はメアド交換したんだ。俺はまだ山科さんのメアド教えてもらってないぞ」
lines.english: “Hey, when did you two exchange email addresses? Yamashina still hasn't given me hers.”

lines.japanese: 「私もぱね田くんに教えるつもりないよ」
lines.english: “And I’m not planning to give you mine either, Paneda.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ俺は一方的に教えるね。はいこれ俺の番号とメアド。嬉しいよね？　友達いない渡来さんなら嬉しいはずだよね。俺いつでもメールとか歓迎だから、帰ったらすぐ送ってね」
lines.english: “Then I'll give you mine unilaterally. Here, my number and email address. Aren't you happy? Somebody with no friends like Watarai has to be happy. I welcome email anytime, so send me one as soon as you get home.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、帰ったらスパムメールの業者さんに、ぱね田くんのアドレスをメールしておくね」
lines.english: “Sure. When I get home, I'll email Paneda's address to a spam company.”

lines.japanese: 「あっこら、ひとのおべんと勝手に開けるな。ああこら、食べるなっ。食べたらそっちの弁当全部食べるぞ」
lines.english: “Hey, don't open somebody else's lunch without asking. Hey! Don't eat it! Take one bite and I'll eat all of yours.”

lines.japanese: ふう、今日はふたりとも休みか。まあ、そういう日もあるだろう。
lines.english: Whew. Both of them were out today. Well, days like that happened.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ今日はふたりで食べよっか」
lines.english: “Then I guess it'll be just the two of us today.”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Yeah.”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　なに羽田班、今からメシ？」
lines.english: “Huh? What, Team Haneda's about to eat?”
“Oh?”

lines.japanese: 珍しいキャラが俺たちの昼食会場へやってきた。例によって、ひとのいい羽田君に雑務でも押しつけるつもりだろうか。
lines.english: An unusual character had entered our lunch venue. Presumably she intended, as usual, to foist some chore upon the good-natured Mr. Haneda.

lines.japanese: 「やあ高内さん、今日も頭の上てんこ盛りだね。そうなんだ、俺たちこれからランチタイムでさあ。だからお仕事があるなら後でいいかな」
lines.english: “Hello, Takauchi. Your hair's piled high as ever. Yes, we're just starting lunch, so if you have work for me, could it wait until later?”

lines.japanese: 「べつに仕事とかないけど。つか今から食べんだったら私も混ぜてよ」
lines.english: “I don't have work for you. If you're only starting now, let me join you.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「今日さ、いつも一緒に食ってる子たちが学食でー、私だけ弁当作ってきてんの。んで、一人だからさ」
lines.english: “The girls I usually eat with went to the cafeteria today, but I made my own lunch. So I'm alone.”

lines.japanese: 言いながら、高内昌子は持ち主の許可を取ることなく、隣の席の椅子へどかりと尻を落とした。ちなみに目の前の席に座る渡来明日香も、持ち主に許可など取ってない。
lines.english: As she spoke, Masako Takauchi planted herself heavily in the seat beside me without asking its owner. For that matter, Asuka Watarai hadn't asked the owner of the desk opposite me either.

lines.japanese: 「ここ座るけどいいよな」
lines.english: “I'm sitting here. That's fine, right?”

lines.japanese: ていうか、もう座ってるよ。
lines.english: You're already sitting there.

lines.japanese: 「うん、友達は多い方がいいからな。大歓迎だぞ」
lines.english: “Sure. The more friends, the better. You're more than welcome.”

lines.japanese: ちらりと隣を見ると、渡来明日香の顔から特に拒否の色は感じられなかった。まあいい子ぶってるお姫様のことだ。ひとの申し出を断るような真似はしないんだろう。
lines.english: I glanced to my side and saw no particular objection on Asuka Watarai's face. The princess liked to play nice. She would never refuse somebody's request.

lines.japanese: 「それじゃいっただっきまー……」
lines.english: “Then let's dig—”

lines.japanese: 「あ、つかさ、羽田おまえの弁当の量少なくね？」
lines.english: “Wait. Haneda, isn't your lunch kinda small?”

lines.japanese: 「え、俺？　いや全然フツーの量だと思うけど」
lines.english: “Mine? No, it looks completely normal to me.”

lines.japanese: 「まあ足りないって言うなら？　私の弁当分けてやってもいいけど？」
lines.english: “Well, if it's not enough, I guess I could share some of mine?”

lines.japanese: 「ううん、足りてるって言ったよ。全くもって平均的な成人男性の食事量だよ」
lines.english: “No, I said it's enough. This is the perfectly average quantity of food for an adult man.”

lines.japanese: 「それに俺がもらったら、高内さんのお昼ごはんが少なくなっちゃうしね」
lines.english: “And if I took yours, you'd have less lunch for yourself.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、私今日、二人分作ってきたから」
lines.english: “Oh, I made enough for two today.”

lines.japanese: 「なんで？」
lines.english: “Why?”

lines.japanese: だが俺の疑問が解消されることはなく、愛妹弁当の隣にアルミの弁当箱がどかりと割りこんできた。
lines.english: But my question went unanswered as a large aluminum lunch box forced its way in beside my loving little-sister lunch.

lines.japanese: 「じゃ、食べよーよ」
lines.english: “Come on, let's eat.”

lines.japanese: 「は、はい」
lines.english: “O-okay.”

lines.japanese: いつの間にか俺は拒否権を失っていた。まあ男の子だから、二杯分くらいはいける……かな。
lines.english: At some point, I had lost the right to refuse. Well, I was a growing boy. I could probably manage two lunches... maybe.

lines.japanese: しかし、この三人で何の会話をしよう。
lines.english: But what were these three people supposed to talk about?

lines.japanese: さっきから高内昌子はひとりで喋りつづけている。渡来明日香は、無難に合いの手を挟んでいる。そして俺は弁当を食べることに没頭していた。
lines.english: Masako Takauchi had been talking by herself the entire time. Asuka Watarai offered safe little interjections. And I devoted myself to eating.

lines.japanese: まあ高内昌子が喋りつづけてるから、こっちから特に会話を投げる必要はない。ないんだけど、でかい声で担任やらＨ組の愚痴を垂れながしつづけるから、まるで俺たちまで批判大会に参加してるみたいだ。
lines.english: Since Masako Takauchi kept talking, I didn't need to introduce a topic. Except she was loudly complaining about our homeroom teacher and Class H, making it look as though we were all participating in the gripe session.

lines.japanese: むう、この世の全てが薔薇色だと受けとめている俺からすると、あまり粘着質な批判はしたくない。声を大にして世界中の全てを誉めちぎりたい。
lines.english: Hmm. To me, everything in the world was rose-colored. I didn’t want to get bogged down in faultfinding. I wanted to shout praise for everything under the sun.

lines.japanese: ていうかもう、世界の全てを愛したい。抱きしめたい。
lines.english: More than that, I wanted to love everything in the world. To take it all in my arms.

lines.japanese: そろそろ話題を、発展性のある方向へ向けたいところだが……。
lines.english: It was time to steer the conversation in a more constructive direction...

lines.japanese: 「でえー、恩ティーのやつ、卒業式のこととか何も言ってこないじゃん？　アレぜって忘れてんだよ。んでさ、二月頃ンなって、うちらに仕切り任せてさー」
lines.english: “And O-T hasn't said a word about graduation, right? He definitely forgot. Then sometime in February, he's gonna dump the whole thing on us and—”

lines.japanese: 「うんうん、恩ちゃんキホン後出しだもんね」
lines.english: “Yeah, yeah. O always waits till the last minute to tell us.”

lines.japanese: 「そ、後出し。のくせ予定通り顔して、しれっと明日までに決めてくださいじゃねっつの。ふざけんな？」
lines.english: “Exactly. Then he acts like it's been the plan all along and calmly tells us to decide by tomorrow. Screw that.”

lines.japanese: 「なるほど、つまり高内さんとしては、積極的に副委員長の活動をしていきたいということだな。素晴らしいじゃないか」
lines.english: “I see. In other words, Takauchi, you want to take a more active role as vice representative. Splendid!”

lines.japanese: 俺は手を叩いて高内昌子を称賛した。
lines.english: I clapped my hands and praised Masako Takauchi.

lines.japanese: 「は？　いや誰がそんなめんどくせーこと」
lines.english: “What? Who'd want to do all that annoying crap?”

lines.japanese: 「いや違うぞ高内さん。過去の悪例を元に、今後の活動をスムーズに進めるよう、予め対策を考えておくとは実に意欲的じゃないか。及ばずながらこの羽田も協力しよう」
lines.english: “No, you misunderstand, Takauchi. Drawing upon past failures to prepare countermeasures in advance and ensure smooth operations in the future—that is true initiative. My humble self will gladly cooperate.”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　おまえなに言って……」
lines.english: “What? What're you talking about...?”

lines.japanese: 「そんな行動力のある高内さんは、今すぐ羽田班にスカウトしたい！　いやむしろ今日から羽田班だ！　ははは、胸が躍るだろう！」
lines.english: “Such a woman of action belongs in Team Haneda immediately! No, as of today, you are already a member! Ha ha ha! Doesn't your heart race?”

lines.japanese: 「はああ！？　だっ、誰が羽田班だコノヤロ。つか勝手に決めてんじゃねーよ！」
lines.english: “What?! Wh-who the hell joined Team Haneda, you asshole? Don't decide for me!”

lines.japanese: 「いやおまえに拒否権はない。何故ならば我が羽田班に優秀な人材は多いが、よく考えれば行動部隊は少なかったからな。俺は高内さんという人材を必要としているんだ。これからシクヨロ」
lines.english: “You have no right to refuse. Team Haneda has many gifted people, but on reflection, too few troops capable of taking action. I need the human resource called Takauchi. Pleased t'meetcha.”

lines.japanese: 「いちばん最初にお願いするのは、いま話した卒業式の実行委員の選出だ。来週までにプランを立てておいてくれ、頼んだぞ高内さん」
lines.english: “Your first assignment will be selecting the graduation-ceremony committee we just discussed. Put together a plan by next week. I'm counting on you, Takauchi.”

lines.japanese: 俺が一気に捲したてると、高内昌子は薔薇色のフラミンゴでも見るかのようにぽかんと口を開いていた。その隣りで渡来明日香が口を押さえて笑っていた。食事中に行儀の悪いやつだ。
lines.english: After I rattled all of that off in one breath, Masako Takauchi gaped as though staring at a rose-colored flamingo. Beside her, Asuka Watarai covered her mouth and laughed. What poor table manners.

lines.japanese: 「どうした、口を開いたままで食べないのか。高内さんの作ってくれた唐揚げはなかなか美味しいよ」
lines.english: “What's wrong? Are you going to sit there with your mouth open instead of eating? The fried chicken Takauchi made is quite good.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、でもうちの妹ほどじゃないけどね。うちの妹がこれまた料理上手くてさあ。あ、俺、シスコンとかロリコンとか全然ないんだけど、妹の話聞きたい？　超かわいいんだよ」
lines.english: “Not as good as my sister's, of course. My sister is an incredible cook. Oh, I don't have a sister complex or a Lolita complex or anything, but would you like to hear about her? She's unbelievably cute.”

lines.japanese: 「はっ」
lines.english: “Hah.”

lines.japanese: 高内昌子は息をひとつ吐きだした。そしてその後、渡来明日香と共に喉の奥で笑いはじめた。
lines.english: Masako Takauchi exhaled once, then began laughing in the back of her throat along with Asuka Watarai.

lines.japanese: 「なー、渡来」
lines.english: “Hey, Watarai.”

lines.japanese: 「なに」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「なんで羽田、こんな暑苦しいやつになっちゃったの」
lines.english: “How'd Haneda turn into such an exhausting guy?”

lines.japanese: 「でしょ。観察したくもなるよね」
lines.english: “See? You can't help wanting to observe him.”

lines.japanese: 「おい。おいそこの二人。本人を目の前に観察とか言うな。失礼極まりないぞ」
lines.english: “Hey. You two. Don't talk about observing someone to his face. That is the height of rudeness.”

lines.japanese: だが失礼だと言ってるにも関わらず、目の前の二人はにやにやしながら俺の顔を眺めはじめた。
lines.english: Despite my complaint, the two women in front of me began smirking and staring at my face.

lines.japanese: 多少怯んだが、それでも俺は怒らなかった。何故なら俺はハンサムだから、見られることには慣れているのだ。
lines.english: I faltered slightly, but I did not grow angry. I was handsome, after all, and accustomed to being watched.

lines.japanese: 「まあそういうわけで、高内さんもめでたく羽田班入りだからな。なにか活動について分からないことがあれば質問を受けつけるぞ」
lines.english: “In any case, Takauchi, congratulations on joining Team Haneda. If you have questions about our activities, I will gladly answer them.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そー。じゃあ一つ聞きたいことあるんだけど」
lines.english: “Oh, yeah? Then there's one thing I wanna ask.”

lines.japanese: 「ん、早速か？　疑問を持つことは積極的な証だ。さあ、なんでも聞いてくれ」
lines.english: “A question already? Curiosity is proof of initiative. Go ahead. Ask me anything.”

lines.japanese: 「萌えって何なん」
lines.english: “What’s this whole ‘melts your heart’ thing?”

lines.japanese: 高内昌子の質問は、俺の求める内容と若干ずれがあった。しかし俺は広い心で質問を受けいれた。
lines.english: Masako Takauchi's question deviated somewhat from the subject I had anticipated. Yet I accepted it with a generous heart.

lines.japanese: 「あー、萌えね。萌え、萌え……ううん、一口で表すのは難しいな」
lines.english: “Ah, heart-melting appeal. Hmm... That’s difficult to sum up in a word.”

lines.japanese: 「なに、羽田って萌えとかそういうの好きなんじゃねーの？」
lines.english: “What, aren’t you into all that heart-melting stuff?”

lines.japanese: 「ん、萌えか？　まあ好きっちゃ好きだけど、逆に言っちゃえば自分の好きなものこそが萌えという考え方もあるしね」
lines.english: “Heart-melting? Well, I guess I am. But you could turn that around and say whatever you like is what melts your heart.”

lines.japanese: 「もっと一般的な話でいいからさ。例えば渡来とか？」
lines.english: “Just give me a general idea. Like, does Watarai melt your heart?”

lines.japanese: 「私は萌えじゃないよ。針生先輩がそう言ってたし」
lines.english: “I’m not the heart-melting type. Kuroudo told me so.”

lines.japanese: 「それ私も言われたぞ。でも一般的には、渡来みたいなんが萌えっつんでしょ？　あいつ信用できねーな」
lines.english: “He said that to me too. But generally, isn’t somebody like Watarai what people mean by heart-melting? I don’t trust that guy.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あの……たしかにあなた方二人は、萌えからは程遠いんですけど……」
lines.english: “Um... To be fair, both of you are about as far from heart-melting as one can get...”

lines.japanese: 「感じ悪ぅ」
lines.english: “Rude.”

lines.japanese: 「感じ悪くないぞ。萌えってべつに誉め言葉じゃないからね」
lines.english: “That wasn’t rude. Heart-melting isn’t necessarily a compliment.”

lines.japanese: 「まあ記号的に言うと、猫耳とかメイド服とかしまパンとか。おまえたちそんなの着ないだろう」
lines.english: “As symbols go, think cat ears, maid outfits, striped panties. Neither of you wears anything like that.”

lines.japanese: 「着ない……ねえ」
lines.english: “No... we don't.”

lines.japanese: 「つかキメぇ」
lines.english: “That's friggin' gross.”

lines.japanese: 「だろう？　だから萌えなんてのは誉め言葉じゃないんだ。場合によっては怒ってもいいくらいだぞ」
lines.english: “Exactly. That’s why heart-melting isn’t a compliment. Depending on the context, you might even be justified in getting angry.”

lines.japanese: 「なるほど。他にはどんなのがあるんだっけ」
lines.english: “I see. What other kinds are there?”

lines.japanese: 「あー、あとアレだよアレ。『お兄ちゃ～ん』とか言う、なんだアレ妹萌え？」
lines.english: “Oh, right. There’s that one. Girls who say, ‘Big Broooother!’ What do they call it, little-sister appeal?”

lines.japanese: 「うわ、きもっ」
lines.english: “Ew. Gross.”

lines.japanese: 「気持ち悪くなどない！」
lines.english: “It is not gross!”

lines.japanese: まったく失礼な女どもだ。俺はごはんをもりもり掻きこみながら、愛妹弁当を残らずたいらげた。
lines.english: What outrageously rude women. I shoveled down great mouthfuls of rice and finished every last morsel of my loving little-sister lunch.

lines.japanese: 「――てなわけで、叔父さんと叔母さんがいなくてさ。小鳩と外で、夕ごはん食べるんだ」
lines.english: “—so Uncle and Auntie won't be home. I'm having dinner out with Kobato.”

lines.japanese: 「だから今日は駄目なんだけど、次は一緒にラーメン屋行こうよ」
lines.english: “That's why I can't today, but let's hit that ramen place next time.”

lines.japanese: 「おう。この雑誌に載ってる店、チョー美味えかンな。ま、俺は結構前から目ェ付けてたけど」
lines.english: “Sure. The place in this magazine is supposed to be crazy good. I had my eye on it way before this, though.”

lines.japanese: 「さっすが森里君、先見の明があるね。流行に敏感な男の子、惚れる惚れるぅ～！」
lines.english: “That's Morisato for you. Always ahead of the curve! A boy with his finger on the pulse—I'm falling for you, falling hard!”

lines.japanese: 「かかか！　まあ、それほどでもねーけど」
lines.english: “Ka-ka-ka! I'm not that great.”

lines.japanese: 森里君との（小鳩の次くらいに）楽しい（だが小鳩の次だとしても森里君との時間は竜宮城での一時に勝る）下校タイム。しかし運命は二人を別とうとしていた。
lines.english: Walking home with Morisato was fun—second only to Kobato, granted, but even in second place, time with Morisato surpassed a sojourn in the Dragon Palace. Yet fate now sought to tear us apart.

lines.japanese: 「あ。じゃあおまえ、蒼穹女学院の方行くんだろ。俺こっちだから。んじゃね」
lines.english: “Oh. You're heading toward Azure Sky Girls' Academy, right? I'm this way. See you.”

lines.japanese: 「うん。森里君、また明日」
lines.english: “Yeah. See you tomorrow, Morisato.”

lines.japanese: ああ、小鳩との約束がなければ、森里君と買い物行きたかったな。一年の頃教えてくれた服屋にも行きたかったし、いま話していたラーメン屋にも行きたかった。
lines.english: Ah, if not for my promise to Kobato, I would have loved to go shopping with Morisato. I wanted to visit the clothing store he'd shown me in our first year, and the ramen shop we'd just discussed.

lines.japanese: せめてあと少し森里君と話がしたいよ！
lines.english: I wanted to talk to Morisato for just a little longer!

lines.japanese: というわけで、俺はポケットから携帯電話を取りだし『ウザそうでウザくないちょっとウザいロン毛』フォルダから、森里君の番号を呼びだした。
lines.english: And so I took out my cell phone and called his number from the folder labeled “Annoying-Looking, Not Annoying, Just Slightly Annoying Longhair.”

lines.japanese: ぷっ　ぷっ　ぷっ　ぷっ
lines.english: Beep. Beep. Beep. Beep.

lines.japanese: ぷるるるるっ……
lines.english: Brrring...

lines.japanese: 『はい、もしもし。どしたん、忘れもの？』
lines.english: “Hello? What's up? Forget something?”

lines.japanese: 「森里君！」
lines.english: “Morisato!”

lines.japanese: 『っつ……！　な、なんだよ、なに大声出してんだよ』
lines.english: “Ow...! Wh-what? Why are you shouting?”

lines.japanese: 「もももももももりっ、もりもりももりもりっ！　おれ、俺だよおれおれ、俺ヨージだよ！」
lines.english: “Mo-mo-mo-mo-Mori, mori-mori-mo-Mori! It's me! Me, me! It's Youji!”

lines.japanese: 『いやそんなん分かってるけど……なに、いま別れたばっかりなのに、そんな慌ててどうしたの』
lines.english: “Yeah, I know that... We just split up. What happened? Why're you freaking out?”

lines.japanese: 「なにって酷いよ森里君！　俺っ、俺さっき森里君に、大切なことを言いわすれたから電話したのに！」
lines.english: “What do you mean? That's awful, Morisato! I called because I forgot to tell you something important!”

lines.japanese: 『お、おお、そうだったんだ。そりゃ悪ぃ。んで、どうしたの』
lines.english: “O-oh. Sorry. So what is it?”

lines.japanese: 「森里君のロンゲは鬱陶しいィィィ！」
lines.english: “Your long hair is annooooying!”

lines.japanese: 『うるっせえ！』
lines.english: “Shut up!”

lines.japanese: 「う、うるさいってなんだよ！　森里君と言えばロンゲがうざいの代名詞、うざいイズ森里君のロンゲだよ！　なのにうるさいって、せっかく教えてあげたのに、酷いじゃない森里君！」
lines.english: “Wh-what do you mean, shut up?! Morisato's long hair is the very definition of annoying! Annoying is Morisato's long hair! I went out of my way to tell you, and now you tell me to shut up? That's horrible, Morisato!”

lines.japanese: 『うるっへええ――っ！　なんでおまえは別れたあとも、いちいち俺に電話かけてこないと気が済まねえんだよこのハゲ！』
lines.english: “Shut the heeell up! Why do you have to call and annoy me every single time we part ways, baldy?!”

lines.japanese: 「ひ、酷いよ、だって俺、森里君のこと大好きなんだもん。だからね、今日は特別ゲストまで用意したんだよ。だから森里君の酷いロンゲを許してよ。森里君に代わって俺が謝るよ」
lines.english: “Th-that's awful. I only do it because I love you, Morisato. That's why I even arranged a special guest for today. So please forgive Morisato's awful long hair. I'll apologize on his behalf.”

lines.japanese: 俺はたまたまそばを通りがかった知人に、ハイどうぞと電話を渡した。
lines.english: I handed the phone with a cheery “Here you are” to an acquaintance who happened to pass by.

lines.japanese: 『なんで俺が俺のロンゲを許すんだよ！　テメ、今日という今日は許さねえぞ！』
lines.english: “Why would I forgive myself for my own hair?! You bastard, I'm not letting you off this time!”

lines.japanese: 『いっつもいっつもひとの髪型うざいうざい言いやがって、おまえにそんなこと言われる筋合いはねえっつーの！』
lines.english: “Every damn day, you call my hair annoying! I don't have to take that shit from you!”

lines.japanese: 『おまえこそ、ぜってーいつかハゲっかんな！　分かってんのかハゲ！　このハゲ！　うざいイズおまえのハゲ！』
lines.english: “You're the one who's definitely going bald someday! You hear me, baldy? Baldy! Annoying is your bald head!”

lines.japanese: 『ハゲたおまえなんか係長にもなれねーかんな！　将来窓際の端っこの席でブラインドの光を眩しがりながら自分のハゲを磨いてろばーかばーか！　そりゃっ、フェニックスのポーズ！』
lines.english: “Once you're bald, you won't even make section chief! You'll spend your future at a dead-end desk by the window, squinting in the light through the blinds while you polish your bald head! Idiot, idiot! Hyaaah! Phoenix pose!”

lines.japanese: 『分かったらもう二度とくだンねーことで電話かけてくんじゃねーぞ。用事があるとき以外にかけてきても、もう電話出ないかんね。分かった？　分かったらもう一回やんぞ。そりゃっ、フェニックスのポーズ！』
lines.english: “Got it? Don't call me again over stupid crap! Unless you actually need something, I'm never answering again. Understood? Good. Then one more time! Hyaaah! Phoenix pose!”

lines.japanese: 「カズ君」
lines.english: “Kazu.”

lines.japanese: 『え、カズく……へっ？』
lines.english: “Kazu...? Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「なに私、電話かけない方がいい？　用事があるとき以外、かけたら殴られ系？　誰が係長だ。ははんだ、もうあははーだ』
lines.english: “What, should I stop calling you? If I call when I don't need anything, do I get punched? Who the hell's a section chief? Ha-ha, right back at you.”

lines.japanese: 『ちょ、ちょちょちょ違げーって！　こっ、これ羽田……じゃなくて、成田のアホが勝手に！　つか聞けよ！　聞いてよ！』
lines.english: “W-wait, no! You've got it all wrong! This is Haneda... I mean, that idiot Narita did this! Listen! Please listen!”

lines.japanese: 「うん聞く。聞くし、今からそっち行く。どこいんの」
lines.english: “Sure, I'll listen. I'm coming over there now. Where are you?”

lines.japanese: 『い、いま、歩道橋の下……つかいま、フツーにおまえら見えてんだけど……』
lines.english: “U-under the pedestrian bridge... Actually, I can see you guys from here...”

lines.japanese: 「首洗って待ってろし」
lines.english: “Just you wait. Your neck’s on the line.”

lines.japanese: 香田は首をぴしゃぴしゃと叩きながら階段を下りていった。あと近くのイタメシ屋のチラシを持っていた。３００円くらい安くなるやつ。
lines.english: Kouda slapped the side of her neck as she descended the stairs. She was also holding a flyer for a nearby Italian restaurant, the kind with a coupon for about three hundred yen off.

lines.japanese: 森里君、今月はお小遣い大丈夫かなあ、ははは。
lines.english: I wondered if Morisato's allowance would survive this month. Ha ha ha.

lines.japanese: さ、俺は愛しい妹の元へ急ご～っと。うふふ、待っててね小鳩ぉ～ん。
lines.english: Now, I would hurry to my beloved little sister. Heehee. Wait for me, Kobatooo.

lines.japanese: っと、いかんいかん。気を抜くとすぐに統合前の小鳩好き好きモードになってしまう。もりもり気をつけねば。
lines.english: Whoa, hold on. The instant I relaxed, I fell right back into my pre-integration love-love-Kobato mode. I had to watch that very carefully.
